subject.title: feat(feishu): bot-to-bot conversation support with @mention handling

question: Should Feishu accept bot-authored messages by default when allowBots is omitted, or should bot-to-bot conversations require an explicit opt-in such as allowBots: "mentions" or allowBots: true?
rationale: The code can support either behavior, but the default determines whether existing Feishu deployments start dispatching bot-authored traffic after upgrade.

options.title: Default accept with loop guard
options.body: Keep the PR's omitted allowBots behavior and rely on loop protection plus docs to prevent runaway exchanges.

options.title: Require explicit opt-in
options.body: Change the default so existing deployments keep ignoring bot-authored events unless operators configure allowBots.

options.title: Mentions-only default
options.body: Accept bot-authored messages only when they mention the bot, reducing surprise while still enabling the common bot-to-bot handoff path.

recommendation.title: Default accept with loop guard
recommendation.body: Keep the PR's omitted allowBots behavior and rely on loop protection plus docs to prevent runaway exchanges.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the listed Feishu/Chinese-channel routing owner and the decision is about Feishu channel product semantics rather than a narrow code typo.
